tenderSchedule.deptName: Department Of Personnel and Administrative Reforms
tenderSchedule.locationName: DPAR Karnataka Bhavan New Delhi (DPAR Karnataka)

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Karnataka Bhavan No,10 Kautilya Marg , Chanakyapuri

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer should have been in the business of providing manpower services for at least 3financialyears preceding the last date for submission of Tenders.
Total number of Manpower deployed for any Central/State Govt./State Bhavans/ Govt Guest House/Semi Govt Preceding 3 years from the last date

Total number of Manpower deployed for any reputed Company Preceding 3 years from the last date for submission of Tenders should have successfully deployed manpower for any reputed company established under the Companies Act, 1956 or 2013 such that the total/combined manpower are not less than 100 persons/users
Total Credit Facility Tenderer should have credit facility of not less than RS.2070000 of credit line or letters of credit from the banks meeting the fund requirement
Training and Demonstration of Work Plan

Total Annual Turnover in the Business of Manpower Services.The Tenderer should have minimum Average Annual Turnover 50000000 from the last three completed financial Years preceding the last date for submission of Tenders i.e. Financial Year 2023-24,2024-25 and 2025-2026
